## Data wrangling

```{r}
#| label: shiny-econ-starter-code

#Read in the data
 air <- read.csv("raw-data/air-pollution(air-pollution).csv", skip = 3)
 climate <- read.csv("raw-data/climate-change.csv", skip = 3)
 co2 <- read.csv("raw-data/co2-emissions(co2-emissions).csv", skip = 3)

 #assign the names of the first row to row names
co2 <- co2|>
  row_to_names(row_number = 1)
air <- air|>
  row_to_names(row_number = 1)
climate <- climate|>
  row_to_names(row_number = 1)


```
